title: After the Tenno Sho (Spring): Defeat and a New Dream

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… I've still got so far to go.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …I lost.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I thought I got better after the pep talk you gave me, but I guess not…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Bourbon?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That was a wonderful race. I wanted to tell you that.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I should be able to race again soon, so let's run together again.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yes! Of course!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mun… I'm still not good enough. Guess it's back to the drawing board for me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But more than anything, Rice was amazing today. Running with her felt so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I still have a long way to go, but I'm gonna keep doing my best to win!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Wonderful! What an optimistic outlook! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: By the way, have you decided on your next race?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Actually, I was thinking it'd be nice if I could run in another race as big as this one.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It might be a bit tricky, but I'd love to run in the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Good choice!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do my best to win it—for real this time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we decide on the Takarazuka Kinen as our next race.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… The track is so quiet in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Um… The Takarazuka Kinen is a right-handed 2,200-meter race on turf, right? So—
Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… I'm not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I must improve myself just as much as Rice and Tannhauser have!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'll take all my disappointment from the spring Tenno Sho and bring it to the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wow… McQueen is really something…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Okay! I've gotta work hard too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time to start training for the medium-distance G1 Takarazuka Kinen in two months!
